unbrowse-ai-unbrowse-root.description: Search and call websites through Unbrowse's hosted API or remote MCP, reuse indexed site tools, read pages, and learn missing routes in its cloud browser. Use for structured website tasks, and authenticated site access with Unbrowse.

unbrowse-ai-unbrowse-unbrowse-contribute.description: Use whenever Unbrowse itself misbehaves - the unbrowse CLI, SDK, stdio MCP proxy or an agent plugin crashes, prints "looks like an Unbrowse bug", exits with the wrong code, ignores a documented flag, or its docs and skill describe something that does not happen; or the hosted service answers 5xx or returns a wrong or empty result for a site it lists. Reproduces it, checks for an existing issue or PR, and opens a fix PR to github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse (or an issue for the hosted side), with the person's OK. Also use for "report this to Unbrowse", "file a bug", "send the fix upstream".
